---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: ["enhancement", "triage"]
assignees: []
---

## Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like.

## Problem / Motivation
What problem does this solve? Who benefits? (Farmers, advisors, developers, specific country?)

## Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you'd like. Include:
- API changes (new endpoints, modified DTOs)
- UI changes (new pages, components, fields)
- Database changes (new tables, columns, migrations)
- Configuration changes (new env vars, config options)

## Alternatives Considered
Other solutions you've thought of and why they're less suitable.

## Implementation Notes (Optional)
- Affected crates: [api, admin-ui, domain, infrastructure, lpis-providers, ...]
- Breaking changes: [Yes/No – describe]
- Migration needed: [Yes/No – describe]
- Testing approach: [unit, integration, manual]

## Context / References
- Related issues/PRs
- External specs (LPIS WFS, PAC regulations, ISO standards)
- User research / farmer feedback
- Screenshots / mockups

## Priority
- [ ] P0 – Critical (blocks release, security, data loss)
- [ ] P1 – High (major user value, MVP feature)
- [ ] P2 – Medium (nice to have, workflow improvement)
- [ ] P3 – Low (polish, technical debt, future-proofing)
- [ ] P4 – Strategic (research, experimental, long-term)

## Willing to Implement?
- [ ] Yes, I'll submit a PR
- [ ] Yes, but need guidance
- [ ] No, just suggesting
